name: Absorption
definition: The process by which material from an administered preparation enters the body. The collagen trial examines the appearance of amino acids in blood after ingestion.

sources.title: Enzymatic Hydrolysis of a Collagen Hydrolysate Enhances Postprandial Absorption Rate—A Randomized Controlled Trial

name: Adverse event
definition: An unfavorable medical occurrence recorded during a study, with causation assessed separately. The eye trial tabulates events and their relationship to study treatment.

sources.title: 0.1% RGN-259 (Thymosin ß4) Ophthalmic Solution Promotes Healing and Improves Comfort in Neurotrophic Keratopathy Patients in a Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Double-Masked Phase III Clinical Trial

name: Amino acid
definition: One of the molecular units that make up proteins and peptides. The collagen absorption paper discusses glycine, proline and hydroxyproline as amino-acid components of collagen.

sources.title: Enzymatic Hydrolysis of a Collagen Hydrolysate Enhances Postprandial Absorption Rate—A Randomized Controlled Trial

name: Area under the curve (AUC)
definition: A summary of concentration across a span of time. In the BPC-157 paper, AUC is the area beneath the plasma concentration-versus-time curve.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

name: Baseline
definition: The starting measurement used for comparison with later observations. The STEP 1 extension reports participant characteristics and changes relative to specified study time points.

sources.title: Weight regain and cardiometabolic effects after withdrawal of semaglutide: The STEP 1 trial extension

name: Bioavailability
definition: The extent to which an administered substance reaches the systemic circulation. The BPC-157 paper estimates absolute bioavailability by comparing dose-adjusted intramuscular and intravenous exposure.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

name: Biomarker
definition: A measurable biological characteristic used to study a process or response. The tirzepatide analysis measures blood lipoprotein-related biomarkers.

sources.title: The dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic peptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist, tirzepatide, improves lipoprotein biomarkers associated with insulin resistance and cardiovascular risk in patients with type 2 diabetes

name: Biomechanical testing
definition: Testing a biological tissue's mechanical behavior. The Achilles repair paper measures the maximum load a repaired rat tendon withstands before failure.

sources.title: Effects of BPC-157 and TB-500 on Achilles tendon healing in rats: A histopathological and biomechanical study

name: Blinding
definition: Keeping specified people in a study unaware of which intervention participants receive. A useful report identifies who was blinded and how.

sources.title: CONSORT 2010 Explanation and Elaboration: updated guidelines for reporting parallel group randomised trials

name: Case series
definition: A description of a group of patients with a shared treatment or condition. The BPC-157 knee report describes treated patients without a randomized control group.

sources.title: Intra-Articular Injection of BPC 157 for Multiple Types of Knee Pain

name: Collagen
definition: A structural protein found in connective tissue. The collagen absorption paper describes it as an important component of bone, tendon, ligament and cartilage.

sources.title: Enzymatic Hydrolysis of a Collagen Hydrolysate Enhances Postprandial Absorption Rate—A Randomized Controlled Trial

name: Control group
definition: The group used as a comparison for the intervention. The Achilles experiment includes a vehicle-treated control group alongside peptide-treated groups.

sources.title: Effects of BPC-157 and TB-500 on Achilles tendon healing in rats: A histopathological and biomechanical study

name: Endotoxin
definition: A bacterial toxin contaminant evaluated separately from viable microbes in the semaglutide product-testing study.

sources.title: Safety and Risk Assessment of No-Prescription Online Semaglutide Purchases

name: Endpoint
definition: The specified outcome a study evaluates. The eye trial defines its primary endpoint as complete healing of the persistent corneal epithelial defect at the designated visit.

sources.title: 0.1% RGN-259 (Thymosin ß4) Ophthalmic Solution Promotes Healing and Improves Comfort in Neurotrophic Keratopathy Patients in a Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Double-Masked Phase III Clinical Trial

name: Extracellular matrix
definition: The material surrounding cells in a tissue. The tendon-cell paper describes a matrix containing collagen and glycoproteins around tendon fibroblasts.

sources.title: Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 Enhances the Growth Hormone Receptor Expression in Tendon Fibroblasts

name: Fibroblast
definition: A connective-tissue cell involved in producing extracellular matrix. The tendon paper describes fibroblasts making collagen and other matrix components during repair.

sources.title: Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 Enhances the Growth Hormone Receptor Expression in Tendon Fibroblasts

name: Formulation
definition: The prepared form of a substance used in a study. The RGN-259 trial, for example, evaluates thymosin β4 in an ophthalmic solution.

sources.title: 0.1% RGN-259 (Thymosin ß4) Ophthalmic Solution Promotes Healing and Improves Comfort in Neurotrophic Keratopathy Patients in a Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Double-Masked Phase III Clinical Trial

name: Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1)
definition: The peptide signal whose receptor is targeted by GLP-1 receptor agonists. The STEP 1 extension describes semaglutide as a GLP-1 analogue.

sources.title: Weight regain and cardiometabolic effects after withdrawal of semaglutide: The STEP 1 trial extension

name: Glucose-dependent insulinotropic peptide (GIP)
definition: A peptide signal discussed in the tirzepatide paper in relation to its receptor and metabolic effects. Tirzepatide is described as acting at both GIP and GLP-1 receptors.

sources.title: The dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic peptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist, tirzepatide, improves lipoprotein biomarkers associated with insulin resistance and cardiovascular risk in patients with type 2 diabetes

name: Growth hormone
definition: A peptide hormone released from the anterior pituitary. The tendon-cell paper describes growth hormone acting through cell-surface receptors and downstream signaling.

sources.title: Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 Enhances the Growth Hormone Receptor Expression in Tendon Fibroblasts

name: Growth hormone secretagogue
definition: A substance that stimulates growth hormone release. The ipamorelin study examines this action by measuring GH concentrations after administration.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic modeling of ipamorelin, a growth hormone releasing peptide, in human volunteers

name: Growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH)
definition: A hormone that stimulates growth hormone release. The CJC-1295 paper studies a long-acting analogue of GHRH.

sources.title: Prolonged stimulation of growth hormone (GH) and insulin-like growth factor I secretion by CJC-1295, a long-acting analog of GH-releasing hormone, in healthy adults

name: Half-life
definition: The time taken for a measured drug concentration to decrease by half during the specified decline phase. The BPC-157 paper reports an elimination half-life for the parent peptide.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

name: Histology
definition: The microscopic study of tissue structure. In the rat Achilles paper, histological evaluation examines stained sections of healing tendons.

sources.title: Effects of BPC-157 and TB-500 on Achilles tendon healing in rats: A histopathological and biomechanical study

name: Hydrolyzed collagen
definition: Collagen processed into smaller peptide fragments by hydrolysis. The cited trial compares collagen preparations that differ in enzymatic processing.

sources.title: Enzymatic Hydrolysis of a Collagen Hydrolysate Enhances Postprandial Absorption Rate—A Randomized Controlled Trial

name: Immunogenicity
definition: The tendency of a therapeutic substance to provoke an immune response against itself. FDA uses this definition for protein therapeutics.

sources.title: FDA: Immunogenicity of Protein-based Therapeutics

name: In vitro
definition: Studied outside a living organism, for example in cultured cells. The BPC-157 tendon paper investigates isolated rat fibroblasts grown in laboratory culture.

sources.title: Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 Enhances the Growth Hormone Receptor Expression in Tendon Fibroblasts

name: In vivo
definition: Studied within a living organism. The BPC-157 pharmacokinetic paper uses in vivo for processes occurring after administration in animals.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

name: Insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1)
definition: A growth factor measured alongside growth hormone in the CJC-1295 study. The paper uses the equivalent spelling IGF-I.

sources.title: Prolonged stimulation of growth hormone (GH) and insulin-like growth factor I secretion by CJC-1295, a long-acting analog of GH-releasing hormone, in healthy adults

name: Intra-articular
definition: Administered within a joint. In the BPC-157 knee report, the term describes injections into the knee.

sources.title: Intra-Articular Injection of BPC 157 for Multiple Types of Knee Pain

name: Intramuscular
definition: Administered into muscle. The BPC-157 pharmacokinetic study abbreviates intramuscular administration as IM.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

name: Intravenous
definition: Administered into a vein. The BPC-157 pharmacokinetic paper abbreviates this route as IV.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

name: Metabolism
definition: The chemical transformation of a substance in the body. The BPC-157 study investigates breakdown of the parent peptide into smaller fragments and amino acids.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

name: Oral
definition: Taken through the mouth. In the collagen absorption trial, oral administration means participants consumed the study preparation as a drink.

sources.title: Enzymatic Hydrolysis of a Collagen Hydrolysate Enhances Postprandial Absorption Rate—A Randomized Controlled Trial

name: Patient-reported outcome
definition: An outcome reported by the participant, such as their experience of pain. The knee study asked treated patients about their knee symptoms.

sources.title: Intra-Articular Injection of BPC 157 for Multiple Types of Knee Pain

name: Peak concentration (Cmax)
definition: The peak measured concentration of a drug in plasma. The BPC-157 paper labels this quantity Cmax.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

name: Pentadecapeptide
definition: A peptide containing fifteen amino-acid units. The tendon-cell paper uses this term for the BPC-157 fragment.

sources.title: Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 Enhances the Growth Hormone Receptor Expression in Tendon Fibroblasts

name: Peptide
definition: A molecule made from a sequence of linked amino-acid units. In the BPC-157 research, the sequence identifies the peptide being tested.

sources.title: Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 Enhances the Growth Hormone Receptor Expression in Tendon Fibroblasts

name: Pharmacodynamics
definition: The measured biological response to a drug and its relationship to exposure. The ipamorelin paper models GH release in relation to ipamorelin concentrations.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic modeling of ipamorelin, a growth hormone releasing peptide, in human volunteers

name: Pharmacokinetics
definition: The study of a substance's concentrations and movement through the body over time. The BPC-157 paper examines absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion in rats and dogs.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

name: Placebo
definition: A comparison preparation without the active intervention being tested, often designed to resemble it.

sources.title: CONSORT 2010 Explanation and Elaboration: updated guidelines for reporting parallel group randomised trials

name: Preclinical
definition: Research used to investigate a potential treatment before establishing its clinical use in people. The BPC-157 pharmacokinetic paper describes its animal and laboratory work as preclinical.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

name: Purity
definition: An analytical measure of the intended substance relative to other material detected by the test. The online semaglutide study reports purity separately from drug content.

sources.title: Safety and Risk Assessment of No-Prescription Online Semaglutide Purchases

name: Randomized controlled trial
definition: A study that uses a chance-based allocation process to assign participants to comparison groups.

sources.title: CONSORT 2010 Explanation and Elaboration: updated guidelines for reporting parallel group randomised trials

name: Receptor
definition: A molecular target through which a signal can act on a cell. The tendon-cell paper describes growth hormone binding to its receptor on the cell membrane and activating intracellular signaling.

sources.title: Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 Enhances the Growth Hormone Receptor Expression in Tendon Fibroblasts

name: Receptor agonist
definition: A substance that activates a receptor. In the tirzepatide paper, agonism refers to activity at the receptors for GIP and GLP-1.

sources.title: The dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic peptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist, tirzepatide, improves lipoprotein biomarkers associated with insulin resistance and cardiovascular risk in patients with type 2 diabetes

name: Retrospective study
definition: A study that looks back at events or treatment that have already occurred. The knee-pain paper describes a retrospective chart review followed by patient contact.

sources.title: Intra-Articular Injection of BPC 157 for Multiple Types of Knee Pain

name: Route of administration
definition: The way a preparation is delivered to the body. The BPC-157 pharmacokinetic study distinguishes intravenous administration from intramuscular administration.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

name: Sterility
definition: Absence of viable microorganisms. The semaglutide product study evaluated microbiological contamination separately from chemical analysis.

sources.title: Safety and Risk Assessment of No-Prescription Online Semaglutide Purchases

name: Subcutaneous
definition: Administered beneath the skin. The STEP 1 report uses subcutaneous, abbreviated s.c., for the semaglutide injections studied in its main treatment phase.

sources.title: Weight regain and cardiometabolic effects after withdrawal of semaglutide: The STEP 1 trial extension

name: Time to peak concentration (Tmax)
definition: The time at which a drug's plasma concentration reaches its peak. This is the meaning given to Tmax in the BPC-157 pharmacokinetic tables.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics, distribution, metabolism, and excretion of body-protective compound 157, a potential drug for treating various wounds, in rats and dogs

name: Topical
definition: Applied to a surface such as the skin. The copper tripeptide skin study examines a preparation applied to skin samples.

sources.title: Human skin penetration of a copper tripeptide in vitro as a function of skin layer

name: Treatment withdrawal
definition: Stopping the study intervention. In the STEP 1 extension, withdrawal means that the trial's semaglutide or placebo treatment was discontinued.

sources.title: Weight regain and cardiometabolic effects after withdrawal of semaglutide: The STEP 1 trial extension

name: Tripeptide
definition: A peptide containing three amino-acid units. GHK refers to glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine; GHK-Cu is its copper complex in the cited skin-penetration study.

sources.title: Human skin penetration of a copper tripeptide in vitro as a function of skin layer
